headline: WHO GAVE
dek: A National Park Service donation account took in $347 million in September. Records don't say who gave the money, The New York Times reports.

means.label: The history:
means.text: Before Trump returned, the account took in less than $100 million a year; it has received about $790 million since, per the Times.

means.label: Undisclosed:
means.text: Records don't name the source or sources, or say if it was one gift or several. The administration declined to say where it came from or what it will fund.

means.label: The spending:
means.text: Trump has used the account to help pay for the White House ballroom, Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool repairs and design work on a planned triumphal arch.

means.label: Interior Dept.:
means.text: Spokesperson Katie Martin: “President Donald J. Trump has done more to make our nation's capital a shining beacon than any other president in the history of this country.”

means.label: A critic:
means.text: Tony Irish of PEER, a former Interior attorney: “Are the donors seeking certain government benefits? We just don't know, because of the lack of transparency.”

sources: Source: The New York Times, Nov. 24, via Mediaite and Quartz.
